races.verdict: A useful sprint. ANYASI had Monday's Musselburgh handicap winner Two Commanders behind in second when comfortably defying a penalty at Leicester last time and even an opening mark of 90 could underestimate this exciting colt. Veblen Good is shaping up to be one of those reliable David O'Meara handicappers and gets the nod for the forecast spot with Conor Whiteley taking a handy 5 lb off. Art Lover , another unexposed 3-y-o, is next on the list ahead of Durham Castle . ANYASI VEBLEN GOOD (IRE) ART LOVER (IRE)

races.verdict: Another useful contest. MIRSKY led for a long way in a strong 1m York handicap last week and is worth chancing having dropped to 1 lb below the mark he defied in the Thirsk Hunt Cup in the spring. Bobby Bennu , Northern Express and Perfect Part are a few of many others to consider, while it'll be very interesting to see how strong the betting vibes are surrounding twice-raced Karl Burke handicap newcomer Majestic Dane . MIRSKY BOBBY BENNU (IRE) NORTHERN EXPRESS (IRE)

races.verdict: A very ordinary maiden hurdle and another chance is given to WACKESTONE up in trip. He hasn't been progressing but clearly has the ability to win a race like this judged on his 2 placed efforts in juvenile events last season and goes in stronger headgear now. Santa Domingo is the clear danger on his hurdles debut. WACKESTONE (IRE) SANTA DOMINGO (IRE) HIDDEN EMPIRE (FR)

races.verdict: KNOCKNAGORAN LADY shaped as if still ahead of her mark at Roscommon last time and could be the answer in a fiendishly difficult handicap. Sneddy Eddie heads the dangers, along with last year's runner-up Schiehallion . Charlie's Dilemma and Astley are also potentially well treated. KNOCKNAGORAN LADY (IRE) SNEDDY EDDIE (IRE) SCHIEHALLION (IRE)

races.verdict: Handicap newcomer MAHLER'S BEST will be suited by this longer trip and she can build on a promising yard debut. Tedworth likely remains on a workable mark and is also shortlisted, whilst Tomas O Maille offered more than he has done for a while at Sligo last week. MAHLER'S BEST (IRE) TEDWORTH (IRE) TOMAS O MAILLE (IRE)
